title: A life in two places
hook: The same insect can change both body form and setting.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The nymph is drawn below the water line, while the adult has wings above it. Dragonfly nymphs live in freshwater and adults are airborne; the drawing omits many details and does not depict a particular species.

misconception: A flying dragonfly has always had the same body and habitat.
objective: In the dragonfly life cycle, which illustrated stage lives underwater?

claims.text: The same insect can change both body form and setting. In the dragonfly life cycle, which illustrated stage lives underwater? The nymph is drawn below the water line, while the adult has wings above it. Dragonfly nymphs live in freshwater and adults are airborne; the drawing omits many details and does not depict a particular species.

claims.text: Recall: A young dragonfly emerges from freshwater and later develops adult wings. Which stage preceded the winged adult? Dragonfly nymphs are the aquatic immature stage.
